description:
social anxiety is a subtle form of self hate

“these peoples opinions of me are more important than my own”

complete nonsense.

what you’re seeking is ACCEPTANCE

but you have to ACCEPT YOURSELF FIRST

(and step up to the standard of life you truly want)

trying to win approval just gets you denied.

allow your AUTHENTICITY to be the filter

calm, collected, confident. thats you in your most NATURAL STATE

You are whole onto yourself... but YOU have to acknowledge that

Stop looking for the world to give you permission to BE REAL
transcript: social anxiety is really just a lack of self-respect. You're looking to other people to tell you who you are. And because of that, you're anxious. Because if they don't respond well to you, that means that you're fundamentally bad. So of course, if you're going out meeting new people, going to a bar, going to a club, out at the beach, having fun, there's going to be some level of anxiety in interacting with people because you think on some level that their opinion is more important than yours and the key to really being free of all this is gaining some self-respect and some love and really knowing who you are knowing where you're headed in your life and actually living on your terms because guaranteed if you were truly living your life on your terms if you were going for what you wanted if you were stabilized if you really loved yourself you wouldn't really have a sense of social anxiety you'd just be getting to know people you'd be chatting with them and whether they like you or not it's like huh this wasn't a good fit. Not for me. No big deal. That's how you really should be when you're coming from a natural, confident place. It's this lack of self-respect that puts other people's opinion above your own and makes it this terrifying event. So start to shift that perspective. Start to be inward out rather than outward in. Stop letting the environment affect you and allow your authenticity to permeate the environment. And then watch what happens.
